# DTGA

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
Dynamic Topology Gating Algorithm that adaptively controls network connectivity in spiking neural networks based on STDP learning. Provides topology-aware control for memristor-based SNNs, optimizing network reconfiguration in TCC systems for energy-efficient computation.
